# LINYANG Machinery

> > Industrial food processing machinery manufacturer specializing in extrusion technology, puffed snacks, nutritional rice, breakfast cereals, and pet feed production lines.

LINYANG is a China-based manufacturer offering comprehensive food processing solutions including twin screw extruders, core filling snack machines, fortified rice production lines, and specialized equipment for breakfast cereals, baby food, and pet feed. The company provides wholesale industrial machinery for food manufacturers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Twin Screw Extruder Technology
- Core Filling Snacks Production
- Puffed Food Processing
- Fortified Rice Manufacturing
- Breakfast Cereal Production Lines
- Pet Feed & Fish Feed Equipment
- Nutritional Baby Food Machinery
- Food Extrusion Technology
- Kurkure & Cheetos Production
- Corn Flakes Manufacturing
- TSP (Textured Soy Protein)
- Instant Rice & Cereal Processing
- Panko Breadcrumbs Equipment
- Wholesale Food Machinery
- Industrial Food Processing
